remaining_limitations: One feedback draw cannot separate sampling variation from all structural and transport errors; no formal Monte Carlo attribution or goodness-of-fit calibration is claimed.
Fixed lognormal margins, age interpolation, older sex split and age-invariant copula correlation remain assumptions; missing residual covariances and US55–64 anchors remain unresolved.
